Which themes is money flowing into?

—
UNDERPERFORMING · RECOVERING
Behind SPY but recovering · watch
OUTPERFORMING · STRENGTHENING
Beating SPY and still speeding up · can enter
UNDERPERFORMING · WORSENING
Behind SPY and still worsening · skip
OUTPERFORMING · FADING
Still beating SPY but fading · warn on holdings
NEUTRAL vs SPY
Close to SPY (within ±ε) · no direction yet
WAITING FOR REFRESH (OLD MODEL)
Old model result · not placed yet
How to read ›
Relative = vs SPY, not price going up/down.
Price chip = the ETF's own trend (40W EMA weekly / 50D EMA daily).
Cycle: Recovering → Strengthening → Fading → Worsening.
Custom model, not JdK RRG.
⚠ SMH · ROBO · IGV · HACK are almost all the same tech cluster — they count for breadth, but not as independent votes

System settings

Accounts
Each account keeps its own data (capital · trades · watchlist · journal · fund-flow) under the same login — switch without signing out
Tick which ports an account uses — unticked ports are hidden across the app
Port goals
Goals are per account (not combined) · shown at the top of the Today tab · % counts from the start value to the due date · portfolio values are entered by hand from the broker (＋ Enter portfolio value on the Today tab) · save/delete apply immediately
Candidate reasons
Reasons you can pick when adding a candidate · rename or deactivate any time (never deleted — old records keep their reason)
Daily routine
Daily time windows Mon–Fri (Thai time) shown on the Today tab · windows must not overlap · save with this section's button
Key news days (Sat)
CPI / NFP / FOMC — enter by hand once a quarter (dates on the Thai calendar) · CPI / NFP: from 1 h before the release until the 30-minute bar after it closes a Sat plan stays placeable at a reduced size (below) · all types: pre-news checklist on the Today tab · times follow US daylight saving, editable · add/edit/delete save immediately
Ideas — groups moving without an idea
When matching a 📋 list: shows Industry groups whose stocks rise together but have no idea yet · this value is shared across devices
Back up to this device
Download all data (accounts · trades · watchlist · settings · Sat plans · weekly bias · Sat setup settings · Macro Playbook · fund-flow · checklist) as a JSON file kept on this device
⚠ The file includes the API key (Twelve Data) — keep it private, do not share
Automatic run: Mac only · every Sunday after 20:00 · a missed week is made up the next time the app opens
Phone / iPad have no automatic run and no reminder bar — the buttons below still work on every device
